event_source: Massive 8-K disclosure taxonomy: quarterly_earnings; QQQ benchmark from Massive adjusted daily aggregates
timing_rule: baseline is the last regular-session close strictly before filing_date; conservative and leak-free when exact release time is unavailable

core_definition.pre20_return_pct: 20-session stock run-up percentile across eligible earnings events
core_definition.pre20_excess_qqq_pct: 20-session stock return minus QQQ return, then percentile across eligible earnings events
core_definition.rs63_change_20d: change in cross-sectional 63-session RS percentile over the prior 20 sessions
core_definition.dist_high63_pct: distance to 63-session high; closer to high maps to higher percentile
core_definition.score: equal-weight mean of all four component percentiles; no missing-component reweighting

enhanced_definition.option_expected_move_pct: (ATM call + ATM put) / stock price using pre-event option prices
enhanced_definition.realized_expected_move_ratio: absolute realized event move / option expected move
enhanced_definition.option_skew: future layer; current IV/Greeks chain snapshot not entitled
enhanced_definition.status: Enhanced score is deliberately null until required inputs are available.
